wren.name: Wren
wren.bio: That's you. You arrived on the evening ferry with a letter of employment you don't remember writing.

odile.name: Odile Vance
odile.bio: Seventy-two. Has run the Office of Unsent Letters for fifty years. Drinks cinnamon tea, writes in violet ink, and is going quietly blind.

notes.text: An only child. Her father went to sea when she was four and never came back.
Hasn't left Hushwater since the night of the Long Storm.
Wrote a letter to Tobias the night before his wedding, in 1985. Never sent it.

tobias.name: Tobias Fenn
tobias.bio: Seventy-six. Keeps the Hushwater Light and lights the lamp by hand every night, though it was made automatic years ago. Says very little.

notes.text: Married Rosa in October 1985. A widower for twenty years.
June is his granddaughter. His son Daniel was her father.
The automatic lamp failed on the night of the Long Storm while he slept. His son was at sea.
He knows about Odile's letter now. Forty-one years late.

mari.name: Mari Fenn
mari.bio: Forty-four. Runs the bakery that never closes, because the sun never rises to tell it to. Laughs easily, cries easily, feeds everyone.

notes.text: Her younger brother Theo left town after their father's funeral, twelve years ago.
Widow of Daniel Fenn, who was lost on the Marguerite.
Rides the 6:10 ferry to Port Ardent every Thursday for flour.

june.name: June Fenn
june.bio: Seventeen. Spends every night at the end of the pier with a brass telescope. Has never once seen the sun rise.

notes.text: Has a one-way ticket on the 6:10 ferry, the morning after Lantern Night.
Her father Daniel was lost on the Marguerite when she was six months old.
Staying in Hushwater. Learning the lamp. Whole heart.
Still leaving on the 6:10 — but not before climbing the lighthouse with her grandfather.

felix.name: Felix Harrow
felix.bio: Fifty-eight. Has spent seventeen years trying to restart the town clock, stopped at 11:52 on the night of the Long Storm. Precise. Prickly. Lonely.

notes.text: Was supposed to crew the Marguerite on the night of the storm. Called in sick.
The town clock is running again.

bram.name: Bram Calloway
bram.bio: Sixty-one. Has captained the ferry to Port Ardent for thirty-one years, runs the harbour Lost & Found, and sings at the wheel. Badly.

notes.text: Turns bright red at any mention of green umbrellas.

theo.name: Theo Okafor
theo.bio: Mari's younger brother. Left Hushwater twelve years ago.
